# DoseTrace

> DoseTrace is a free personal journal and arithmetic calculator for iPhone and Android, published by Outcom. It records what you enter. It does not recommend a dose, diagnose, or interpret lab results. Optional paid Premium is sold inside the app. This file is a short summary. It does not control search ranking.

DoseTrace is for a person's own records. It is not for a healthcare professional dosing a patient.

## What the app does

- Dose log with reminders and history
- Syringe and reconstitution calculators that only do arithmetic
- Vial tracking, with an alert when about 7 days of use are left
- Lab results stored by marker, with a chart over time and no interpretation
- Weigh-ins and a food log
- An estimated accumulation curve from logged doses
- A 30-day adherence report
- Six languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, and Italian

## Free arithmetic pages

- [How do I convert mg or mcg to mL for a syringe?](https://dosetrace.io/how-to-convert-mg-to-ml-for-a-syringe): volume from an amount and a concentration, plus insulin-syringe units only for the calibration printed on that syringe (U-100 or U-40).
- [How do I calculate a reconstitution concentration?](https://dosetrace.io/how-to-calculate-reconstitution-concentration): mass divided by liquid volume.
- [How do I convert mcg to mg and mg to mcg?](https://dosetrace.io/how-to-convert-mcg-and-mg): the factor is 1000.
- [How do I calculate a fraction of a tablet?](https://dosetrace.io/how-to-calculate-a-tablet-fraction): fraction arithmetic only. It does not say that a tablet can be split.
